event.quote: On November 22, 2026, the Board of Directors of NVIDIA Corporation reinstated Jen-Hsun Huang as NVIDIA's President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Board of Directors, effective immediately.

watch.note: Headlines report that Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO after an 11-day period in which he had resigned, and that he has returned to cheers in China.

digest.summary: US stocks were mixed on Tuesday, with the S&P 500 sitting 7.7% below its one-year high. Headlines point to renewed selling in AI-related shares, including Nvidia, which gave back part of a large rally after CEO Jensen Huang's reinstatement, and Analog Devices, which fell nearly 20% despite strong results. Some reports describe a tariff proposal and AI-stock weakness weighing on sentiment. The headlines do not give a single clear cause for the broader index move.
digest.fed_note: The Fed headlines are routine items (minutes of the October 27-28 FOMC meeting and discount rate meetings, plus administrative notices), and none states a clear policy direction.
digest.sector_note: The headlines do not explain why the consumer staples sector is holding up.
